_comment: The mock project, in creation order. Ids are assigned in this order, so LP-1..LP-7 are stable. Each row is here for one reason; see README.md.

issues.title: Payments
issues.body: The remote root: nothing above it, so it is filed with no parent at all.

issues.title: Card payments
issues.body: Depth 1. Beyond Jira's native reach on a leaf anchor, so its parent rides the managed block.

issues.title: Refunds
issues.body: Depth 2, also block-carried. Its status is the active one, which Jira reaches by transition.

issues.title: Chargebacks
issues.body: A second feature, so there is somewhere for the reparent scenario to move a story to.

issues.title: Refund a voided charge
issues.body: Finished before it was ever pushed. Jira cannot set a status on create, so this is the document that proves the create transitions.

issues.title: Refund a captured charge
issues.body: Depth 3: the first level Jira holds natively. Carries the sprint and the one dependency.

issues.title: Write the refund ledger entry
issues.body: Depth 4: the second native level, filed as a Jira Subtask under its story.
